summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ADX indicator feature. All core functionality working correctly - ADX defined in indicator_registry.py, backend accepts strategies with ADX filters, frontend Filters step (step 6 of 7) shows ADX filter option with period/operator/value inputs, strategy summary displays ADX filter info, and explainStrategy.js correctly formats ADX filter text.

minor.issue: Backend does not validate ADX operators against indicator_registry.py - accepts invalid operators like 'cross_above' for ADX (should only allow '>' and '<')
minor.note: indicator_registry.py has validate_strategy_json() but server.py doesn't use it

passed_tests: ADX indicator defined in indicator_registry.py with params=['period'] and operators=['>', '<']
POST /api/strategy accepts strategy with ADX filter using '>' operator
POST /api/strategy accepts strategy with ADX filter using '<' operator
POST /api/strategy accepts strategy with custom ADX period (28)
POST /api/strategy accepts strategy without ADX filter
GET /api/strategies returns list including ADX strategies with correct filter data
Frontend Filters step (step 6 of 7) shows 'ENABLE ADX FILTER' checkbox
Enabling ADX filter shows ADX Filter (Trend Strength) card
ADX filter card shows Period input with data-testid='input-filter-period'
ADX filter card shows Operator dropdown with data-testid='select-filter-operator'
ADX filter card shows Value input with data-testid='input-filter-value'
ADX filter helper text shows 'Only enter trades when ADX(period) operator value'
Strategy Summary on Risk step displays ADX filter info (e.g., 'Filter: ADX(20) > 30')
explainStrategy.js formatFilter() correctly formats ADX filter as 'Filter: ADX(period) above/below value'
My Strategies page displays ADX filter info in strategy descriptions
Full E2E: Created strategy with ADX filter enabled and verified it saved correctly
action_items: OPTIONAL: Import and use validate_strategy_json() from indicator_registry.py in server.py to reject invalid ADX operators
critical_code_review_comments: indicator_registry.py has validation logic (validate_strategy_json, validate_condition) but server.py doesn't use it - validation is bypassed
seed_data_creation: Created 7 test strategies with various ADX filter configurations via pytest
context_for_next_testing_agent: ADX indicator feature fully implemented and tested. Backend accepts ADX filters with period param and >/< operators. Frontend has Filters step (step 6 of 7) with ADX filter UI. Note: Backend validation from indicator_registry.py is not enforced in server.py - invalid operators are accepted.
